Hello Honshiya-san! I love your art! 

I would like for you to draw my OC Cider. Cider has many hair styles, but she will always have pink diamond shaped pupils and hair that resembles cat ears. When her eyes are visible, her personality is very crass and she frowns a lot. When she has her long bangs and pigtails hair, she is always smiling.

You may pick any hair style of hers that you would prefer to draw. Please draw whatever you like! She also has two cat mascots if you'd like to draw that as well. 

I will use this for SNS and YouTube. Thank you!

・己が狂っている自覚はありませんし、全ての行動源は好意からなので　相手も喜んでいると思っています。
